content.text:
Diagnosis first — less is unpushed than the branch list suggests:

| Item | State |
|---|---|
| `main` cf90487 "Mempalace and mnemosyne for all" | **Only genuinely unpushed work.** Committed directly onto `main` |
| `openai-tunnel-remove` 858ad23 | Already on origin, **PR #31 open**. Local sha == PR head. Missing only local upstream config |
| `qwen38-default-model` 51e3d95 | Already on origin, **PR #32 open**. Local sha == PR head. Same |
| `ash4d-site-origin`, `gpu-thermal-guard` | In sync with origin, unmerged, no PR |
| `buzz-chart-017-relay-021`, `buzz-pairing-relay` | Merged (PRs #33/#34), remotes pruned — stale locals |

Two things make "correctly" a decision rather than a `git push`:

- **Convention**: every substantive change in the last 20 commits landed via `Merge pull request #NN from darthzen/<branch>`. cf90487 sits directly on `main`. `main` is unprotected, so a direct push succeeds — it just breaks the pattern.
- **Message**: "Mempalace and mnemosyne for all" doesn't match the `<dir>: <what>` convention used everywhere else, and the commit spans two dirs (`06-milvus/lan/`, `18-lab-memory/raw/`). It's unpushed, so rewriting is free.

content.text:
Done and verified.

**PR #36** — https://github.com/darthzen/lab-fleet/pull/36

- Branch `lab-memory-mempalace-mnemosyne` at `c50535c`, base `main`. Remote head SHA matches local exactly.
- Message rewritten to `18-lab-memory: add mempalace-mcp and mnemosyne bundles` with a body covering both dirs.
- `main` reset to `origin/main` (`a5b69a6`) — no direct-to-main commit left behind.
- Deleted stale locals `buzz-chart-017-relay-021` (fc75440) and `buzz-pairing-relay` (5ae8538), both already merged via PRs #33/#34.
- `git log --branches --not --remotes` returns empty: every local commit is now on origin.

**Two things I did not touch:**

- **PRs #31 and #32 are still open from Aug 18** — `openai-tunnel-remove` and `qwen38-default-model`. Both were already fully pushed; nothing was stuck. They're six days old and unmerged. You didn't ask me to merge them, so I left them.
- `ash4d-site-origin` (fe2ef57) and `gpu-thermal-guard` (a884d51) are pushed and in sync with origin but have **no PR** — the work is on GitHub, just never proposed for merge.

Also: `gh` can't infer the repo from the `entire://` remote, so every `gh` call in this repo needs `-R darthzen/lab-fleet`.
